profile.headline: Senior Web Software Engineer | Building Scalable, Accessible, SEO-Optimized Web Applications | AWS, Agile, AI | Raytheon / RTX / JPL / NASA / NOAA
profile.jobTitle: Senior Web Software Engineer – Raytheon / RTX (Contractor to NASA, JPL, and NOAA)
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Web Software Engineer with 22+ years of experience in full stack web development, specializing in designing, building, and optimizing scalable, data-driven web applications. My work spans the full project lifecycle — from requirements gathering and system architecture to implementation, optimization, and long-term maintenance.

My preferred focus is UI/UX development, where I combine deep technical expertise with design thinking to create intuitive, accessible, and visually engaging user experiences that are SEO and Section 508 compliant, meeting both modern accessibility and performance standards.

I have experience applying AI tools and models, along with Agile development, Amazon Web Services (AWS), database architecture, CMS platforms, and scientific research tools, enabling me to deliver robust, innovative, and user-centric web applications across diverse domains.

🏆 Awards & Recognition
•	NASA Honor Award: MSL Hosting Architecture Group Achievement Award
•	NOAA 2024 Team Member of the Year Award
•	Multiple individual, team, and spot awards recognizing technical innovation, leadership, and project excellence

🚀 High-Profile NASA Projects (Prior to 2018)
•	Developed and maintained Mars Raw Image Systems for the MSL (Curiosity) Rover mission
•	Maintained Mars Raw Image Systems for Mars Exploration Rovers (Spirit and Opportunity)
•	Developed “Send Your Name to Mars” web applications for the Curiosity Rover Mission and Orion Flight Test
•	Developed “Name the Rover” web application for the Curiosity Rover Mission

🌟 What I Bring
With over two decades of hands-on experience, I bring a blend of technical excellence, creative problem-solving, and strategic vision. My approach emphasizes performance, scalability, accessibility, and innovation—ensuring every solution I design not only meets mission-critical goals but also delivers outstanding, inclusive, and search-optimized user experiences.

positions.title: Senior Web Software Engineer – Raytheon / RTX (Contractor to NASA, JPL, and NOAA)
positions.description:
🔧 Core Expertise
•	Full Stack Development: End-to-end web and application development (front-end, middle-tier, back-end)
•	UI/UX & Accessibility: Designing responsive, user-centric interfaces that are SEO and Section 508 compliant
•	AI Integration: Applying AI tools and models across research, design, and development workflows
•	Agile Development: Iterative, collaborative, and adaptive project execution
•	System Design & Migration: Modernizing legacy systems (e.g., Excel → Web-enabled workflow platforms)
•	Cloud & Cost Optimization: Amazon Web Services (AWS) cost analytics, forecasting, and identifying savings
•	SEO & Analytics: SEO setup, Google Analytics (GA) and Google Tag Manager (GTM) configuration and maintenance
•	Database Architecture: SQL, MySQL, Oracle, PL/SQL, JSON, XML — design, development, and optimization
•	CMS & Frameworks: WordPress, Wagtail (Django/Python), Sitecore, Drupal, custom CMS solutions
•	Research & Publications: Google Scholar research, subscriptions setup, and management
•	Application & Web Security: Ensuring secure and reliable web applications
________________________________________
💻 Technical Stack
•	Front-End: HTML, HTML5, CSS, CSS3, Sass, Tailwind, JavaScript, jQuery, Vue, Bootstrap, Ajax, API, JSON, XML
•	Back-End: Python/Django, Wagtail, ColdFusion, PHP, Sitecore, WordPress, Drupal
•	Cloud & Data: AWS (EC2, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda), SQL, MySQL, Oracle, PL/SQL, Stored Procedures, Views, JSON, XML
•	Legacy Experience: ASP, VBScript, Visual Basic, C++, Java, MS Access, Crystal Reports, jQuery Mobile, Angular
________________________________________
🚀 High-Profile Projects
•	Developed and maintained Mars Raw Image Systems for the MSL (Curiosity) Rover mission
•	Maintained Mars Raw Image Systems for Mars Exploration Rovers (Spirit and Opportunity)
•	Developed “Send Your Name to Mars” web applications for the Curiosity Rover Mission and Orion Flight Test
•	Developed “Name the Rover” web application for the Curiosity Rover Mission
positions.insights: Skills: UI/UX · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Full-Stack Development · Web Analytics · WordPress · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Content Managed Websites · Data Analysis · Database Design · Database Development · Generative AI Tools

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Worked as a team member to provide management solutions and billing services for the healthcare industry. Developed, maintained standalone and web based applications (Visual Basic 6.0, Access, VB.NET, ASP): analysis, flowcharting, design, coding, testing, debugging, packaging and deployment. Created Access and Crystal Reports. Worked with SQL and Access database. Performed data analysis, SQL coding, wrote stored procedures, views and transaction files. Wrote VB modules to create NSF billing files to be submitted to insurance companies and to process payments electronically.

positions.title: ColdFusion Programmer - Short Term Contract
positions.description: Helped Sr. Programmer to troubleshoot, maintain, debug and expand the company intranet website and database using ColdFusion, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, DHTML, MS Visual SourceSafe and Crystal Reports. Analyzed, designed and developed new web pages. Performed data modeling. Analyzed, flow-charted and coded data flow on the intranet website.

positions.title: Professor's Assistant / Faculty Assistant
positions.description: Provided tutoring support to students who were having difficulties with Visual Basic programming. Analyzed, tested, debugged and evaluated VB programs, written by students. Assisted in grading homework, quizzes and lab assignments. Assisted professor during Visual Basic problem solving sessions with students.

positions.title: Manager of Inside Sales and Promotions
positions.description: Managed a Russian Internet based company office in Southern California. Marketed tours and membership to potential and existing  clients. Coordinated all Beautiful Dream Network advertising in newspapers and magazines. Managed sales and promotions to American clients. Researched and booked all services for tours as needed.
